items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Jones, he said, “Duke’s not going to pay that kind of money to you as a sideman.

ctx.x: I think it was $100. I think something like that. It was very low compared to what I was making. And there was no negotiations. I said, “This is what I’m making. Can he come up to that?” And Jones, he said, “Duke’s not going to pay that kind of money to you as a sideman. He don’t pay that money to a sideman.” I said, “Everybody in the band is a sideman. What are you talking about?” He said, “Yeah, but the soloists – you’re just – in the rhythm section we don’t pay anybody that.” Sonny Greer was a part of Duke’s…
Anything else you’d like to share about that?
